critical_variant_guards: D15 assigns JA panel/lever to its spoke group and DS to its alloy group, but D04BM125UG shows a cast-five-branch wheel and cites JA parts; JA therefore is not universally incompatible with alloy wheels.
Neither catalogue certifies the current RDC125HD part identity; do not automatically replace candidate JA with DS or certify JA assembly.
A no-crossing BVH test on estimated geometry proves local geometric clearance only, not OEM fit, shaft/bearing dimensions, brake operation or seal.
D04 wheel/tyre descriptions include tubes whereas D01 current-market page says tubeless. Keep current-market tubeless target; do not introduce an inner tube because an older catalogue contains it.
D15 BM150spoke rear tyre100/90-17 and rim2.15in do not replace D01 RDC3.00-17 rear tyre or establish its rim width.
Spoke/alloy,125/150,4/5gear, fairing/no-fairing and regional revisions must remain separate.
D04 quantities4 for front brake panel and2 for chain are not accepted as real installed counts.
D04 rear drive6 fasteners versus D15 alloy4 fasteners must stay alternative groups.
D04 coupling rubber quantity4 versus D15 alloy quantity1 may describe different kit segmentation, not proof of identical physical count.
Double concentric spring appearance is supported by related PF122033 photograph; do not certify PF122033 as current RDC or count hidden coils.
340mm shock length and12/10mm eye bore search snippets remain rejected;17inch is bead-seat diameter, not wheel outside diameter.
